summary.title: In short
items: AdiletAI assists lawyers. It does not provide legal advice or act as your lawyer.
Output is generated by AI and can be incomplete, outdated or wrong, even when it cites sources.
Check every citation against the official text of the act or court decision before you rely on it.
Court practice analysis is research support, not a forecast of how a court will decide.
Professional responsibility for advice, filings and decisions stays with you and your organisation.
